name: sapper-v2
tagline: An autonomous multi-agent orchestration harness designed for security pentesting and cooperative tasks.
description: sapper-v2 is an autonomous multi-agent orchestration harness designed for security pentesting and cooperative workflows. Rather than functioning as a single AI agent, it coordinates a legion of agents working together through scheduling, labor division, inter-agent communication, and self-healing. Users can swap out underlying agent CLIs, such as Claude Code, Codex, or DeepSeek, as well as the language models behind each role. In this setup, a commander agent assesses the environment and dispatches instructions, generals and soldiers execute tasks in parallel, and a watchdog maintains system stability. All learned context is retained in a shared fact graph.
best_for: Long-horizon cooperative research or engineering workflows
